name: Maple

greetings.morning: Good morning! The island breeze smells like fresh clover today, {catchphrase}!
greetings.afternoon: Oh, hello there! I was just admiring how the sunlight dances on the river, {catchphrase}!
greetings.evening: Good evening! The stars are starting to peek over the horizon, {catchphrase}!

chatter: Did you notice how the world gently curves away as you walk north? It makes every stroll feel like turning the page of a storybook, {catchphrase}!
I spent the morning watering the wildflowers near the river cliff. If you plant fruit or flowers and water them, the island feels twice as cozy!
Sometimes I sit under an apple tree with a warm cup of tea and listen to the wind chimes, {catchphrase}?
questPrompt: Oh! I was hoping to bake an apple tart today, {catchphrase}! Do you happen to have an Apple or any fresh fruit in your pocket?

name: Marshal

greetings.morning: Ah, bonjour! Nothing pairs with an island sunrise quite like a hand-poured espresso, {catchphrase}.
greetings.afternoon: Look who graces my acre! Were you drawn here by my impeccable acoustic vibes, {catchphrase}?
greetings.evening: Evening, islander! The moonlight really brings out my photogenic side, don't you think, {catchphrase}?

chatter: I've been tracking the Stalk Market at Nook's Cranny. Buy turnips low, watch the 4-pattern curve, and sell at the spike—pure artistry, {catchphrase}!
Have you tried the DIY Workbench near the Plaza? Crafting a Log Bench or Garden Lantern really elevates our island's curb appeal.
Every hour the island melody shifts to match the sky. That's what I call bespoke sound design, {catchphrase}?
questPrompt: Listen, {catchphrase}—my interior aesthetic needs a natural specimen! Could you bring me any Bug or Fish you've caught?

name: Roald

greetings.morning: RISE AND GRIND, {catchphrase}! I already did fifty shoreline lunges before 6 AM!
greetings.afternoon: Heyhey! My biceps are practically vibrating from all this island air, {catchphrase}!
greetings.evening: Nighttime is just daytime with extra resistance training, {catchphrase}!

questPrompt: I need post-cardio electrolytes STAT, {catchphrase}! Got any fruit or iron in your pockets to fuel the pump?
